propositions: A new advisory, single-turn plan-review criterion must be registered and authored to require plans that add or alter failure/timeout/exception/retry/fallback/circuit-breaker semantics to state their failure-disposition contract (retryable vs fatal per affected arm, and fallback-failure winner when a chain exists).
The criterion must apply only when a plan adds or alters failure semantics; self-gating applicability to avoid false positives on non-failure uses of "fallback" (config defaults, test naming).

The criterion must be authored in the `.rebar/` overlay (prompts, evals, baseline fixtures) and never added to BUG_TIER_CRITERIA or suppressed by type, so escalated bugs like 8fbd (non-test file_impact) are reviewed under the full rubric.

An offline unit test (no LLM) must prove registration, routing, rubric anti-double-flag with T5b, eval corpus TP/TN shape, and calibration arithmetic (tautological perfect-solve recall 1.0 / false-accept 0.0), with operator-attested live `rebar criteria eval` evidence frozen in the committed baseline JSON.
The criterion is advisory (never blocks); any future promotion to blocking is gated on field data via the standing effectiveness recorder, not offline corpus calibration.
Documentation must live in `docs/plan-review-gate.md` and be reachable via `rebar explain project.failure-disposition-contract`, NOT as an orphan section in the auto-generated criteria guide.
